chunks.en: a **geneticist** at the University of Leicester,
chunks.zh: 一位**遗传学家**(geneticist)在莱斯特大学（任职），
在一张X光片上**辨认出**(discerned)一些**分子**(molecular)**标记**(markers)，
chunks.note: （宾语 molecular markers 带着 whose 从句，所以放到了状语后面）

chunks.zh: 这些标记的**排布**(layout)在人与人之间**相差**(varied)**相当大**(considerably)。

actual_original_native_sentence_timing.spoken_English: On 10 September 1984 Alec Jeffreys, a geneticist at the University of Leicester, discerned on an X-ray film molecular markers whose layout varied considerably from person to person.
